entities.summary: Robin Devenish was a physicist at the University of Oxford. An Emeritus Fellow of Hertford College, Devenish was a former Dean of Hertford College, University of Oxford, Fellow and Tutor of Physics. He was known for his work in the field of deep inelastic scattering, and was awarded the Max Born Prize in December 2009 for his work in this field, in which he was active until his death.
